mentions.name: Quickswell
mentions.description: A surf forecasting website similar to Surfline, offering its own surf forecast features plus an API (built originally to feed a Tidbyt display), currently covering only Southern California spots.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a surf forecasting site a la surfline.com, I started mostly to have an API to use for my tidbyt, but I figured I might as well make it a full thing and built my own features! It's on quickswell.com but it's only Socal at this time (fewer spots to compute)
